title: 慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋
subcategoryTitle: 地標建築與大跨度屋蓋
summary: 慕尼黑奧林匹克公園的帳篷屋蓋由多片鞍形索網組成，總面積約 74,800 m²，覆蓋體育場、體育館與游泳館，網目統一為 75 × 75 cm，上鋪約 8,300 片壓克力板。課程從負高斯曲率索網的預拉平衡與邊索、桅桿、重力錨塊的傳力出發，處理等網目索網與鑄鋼節點、壓克力板的熱脹與接合、地面編網吊升與預拉力導入，再談由實體模型走向迭代電腦計算的形狀確認、安裝量測、板材老化更換，以及列管古蹟屋蓋的重新計算與維護。
summaryEn: The tent roof of Munich's Olympic Park consists of several saddle-shaped cable nets totalling about 74,800 m² over the stadium, arena and swimming hall, all with a uniform 75 × 75 cm mesh and covered by about 8,300 acrylic panels. The course starts from prestress equilibrium of anticlastic nets and the load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchor blocks, then covers the uniform-mesh net and cast-steel nodes, thermal movement and fixing of acrylic panels, ground assembly, lifting and introduction of pretension, and the move from physical models to iterative computer form finding, before turning to as-built survey, panel ageing and replacement, and recalculation and maintenance of a listed roof.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「負高斯曲率鞍形索網的預拉平衡」與「邊索、桅桿與重力錨塊的傳力」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Prestress equilibrium of anticlastic saddle nets" and "Load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchors": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 負高斯曲率鞍形索網的預拉平衡：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Prestress equilibrium of anticlastic saddle nets: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鞍形索網曲面」如何影響慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Saddle-shaped net surfaces” governs force, deformation or durability in “Munich Olympic Stadium roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 奧運屋蓋是由多片鞍形曲面組成的索網：一組索向下垂（懸掛索），另一組向上拱（穩定索），兩組在每個節點互相拉住，形成負高斯曲率。沒有外載時，兩組索的預拉力在節點上平衡；積雪等向下荷載由懸掛索增張、穩定索減張來承擔，風吸力則相反。只要兩組索都保持受拉，網就有雙向勁度；任何一組鬆弛，該方向的勁度消失，網會大幅變形甚至拍動。因此預拉力的大小必須讓兩組索在所有荷載組合下都不鬆弛。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鞍形索網曲面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Olympic roof is a cable net of several saddle surfaces: one family of cables sags downward (hanging cables) and the other arches upward (stabilising cables), pulling against each other at every node to form negative Gaussian curvature. With no external load the prestress of the two families balances at each node; downward loads such as snow are carried by tension increasing in the hanging family and decreasing in the arching family, and wind suction does the opposite. As long as both families stay in tension the net is stiff in both directions; if either goes slack, stiffness in that direction disappears and the net deforms heavily or flutters. Prestress must therefore be large enough that neither family slackens in any load combination. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Saddle-shaped net surfaces” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：節點平衡 p = t₁/R₁ − t₂/R₂（t 為單位寬度張力）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Node equilibrium gives p = t₁/R₁ − t₂/R₂, with t as tension per unit width.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「索網只要索夠粗、夠強，就不需要預拉力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cable net needs no prestress as long as the cables are thick and strong enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鞍形索網曲面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Saddle-shaped net surfaces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 負高斯曲率鞍形索網的預拉平衡
knowledge.titleEn: Prestress equilibrium of anticlastic saddle nets
knowledge.text: 奧運屋蓋是由多片鞍形曲面組成的索網：一組索向下垂（懸掛索），另一組向上拱（穩定索），兩組在每個節點互相拉住，形成負高斯曲率。沒有外載時，兩組索的預拉力在節點上平衡；積雪等向下荷載由懸掛索增張、穩定索減張來承擔，風吸力則相反。
knowledge.textEn: The Olympic roof is a cable net of several saddle surfaces: one family of cables sags downward (hanging cables) and the other arches upward (stabilising cables), pulling against each other at every node to form negative Gaussian curvature. With no external load the prestress of the two families balances at each node; downward loads such as snow are carried by tension increasing in the hanging family and decreasing in the arching family, and wind suction does the opposite.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：索網只要索夠粗、夠強，就不需要預拉力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A cable net needs no prestress as long as the cables are thick and strong enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「負高斯曲率鞍形索網的預拉平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Prestress equilibrium of anticlastic saddle nets" is correct?
options: 索網只要索夠粗、夠強，就不需要預拉力。
奧運屋蓋是由多片鞍形曲面組成的索網：一組索向下垂（懸掛索），另一組向上拱（穩定索），兩組在每個節點互相拉住，形成負高斯曲率。
錨塊夠重就能錨住索結構，水平拉力不重要。
optionsEn: A cable net needs no prestress as long as the cables are thick and strong enough.

The Olympic roof is a cable net of several saddle surfaces: one family of cables sags downward (hanging cables) and the other arches upward (stabilising cables), pulling against each other at every node to form negative Gaussian curvature.
A heavy enough anchor block secures a cable structure, so horizontal pull does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 奧運屋蓋是由多片鞍形曲面組成的索網：一組索向下垂（懸掛索），另一組向上拱（穩定索），兩組在每個節點互相拉住，形成負高斯曲率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Olympic roof is a cable net of several saddle surfaces: one family of cables sags downward (hanging cables) and the other arches upward (stabilising cables), pulling against each other at every node to form negative Gaussian curvature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 負高斯曲率鞍形索網的預拉平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Prestress equilibrium of anticlastic saddle nets: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鞍形索網曲面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Saddle-shaped net surfaces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：節點平衡 p = t₁/R₁ − t₂/R₂（t 為單位寬度張力）。無外載時 t₁/R₁ = t₂/R₂；取 R₁ = 40 m、R₂ = 60 m、t₂ = 15 kN/m，則 t₁ = 10 kN/m。若 1.0 kPa 雪載由兩組各承一半，Δt₁ = +0.5×40 = +20 kN/m，Δt₂ = −0.5×60 = −30 kN/m，穩定索變為 15 − 30 = −15 kN/m，即鬆弛；網目 0.75 m 時每根索初拉約 11.3 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Node equilibrium gives p = t₁/R₁ − t₂/R₂, with t as tension per unit width. With no load t₁/R₁ = t₂/R₂; taking R₁ = 40 m, R₂ = 60 m and t₂ = 15 kN/m gives t₁ = 10 kN/m. If a 1.0 kPa snow load is shared equally, Δt₁ = +0.5×40 = +20 kN/m and Δt₂ = −0.5×60 = −30 kN/m, so the arching family becomes 15 − 30 = −15 kN/m, which means slack; with a 0.75 m mesh each arching cable starts at about 11.3 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以非線性索網分析逐一檢查每個網區在雪載、風吸力、溫度與不對稱荷載下兩組索的最小張力，確認全部大於零並保有餘裕；同時檢查最大張力對索與節點的強度，以及網面最大變位是否會讓覆板之間的接縫失效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check with nonlinear cable-net analysis, zone by zone, the minimum tension in both cable families under snow, suction, temperature and asymmetric loads, confirming all stay above zero with margin; also check maximum tension against cable and node strength, and whether maximum net displacement would break the joints between cover panels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 節點平衡 p = t₁/R₁ − t₂/R₂（t 為單位寬度張力）。無外載時 t₁/R₁ = t₂/R₂；取 R₁ = 40 m、R₂ = 60 m、t₂ = 15 kN/m，則 t₁ = 10 kN/m。若 1.0 kPa 雪載由兩組各承一半，Δt₁ = +0.5×40 = +20 kN/m，Δt₂ = −0.5×60 = −30 kN/m，穩定索變為 15 − 30 = −15 kN/m，即鬆弛；網目 0.75 m 時每根索初拉約 11.3 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Node equilibrium gives p = t₁/R₁ − t₂/R₂, with t as tension per unit width. With no load t₁/R₁ = t₂/R₂; taking R₁ = 40 m, R₂ = 60 m and t₂ = 15 kN/m gives t₁ = 10 kN/m. If a 1.0 kPa snow load is shared equally, Δt₁ = +0.5×40 = +20 kN/m and Δt₂ = −0.5×60 = −30 kN/m, so the arching family becomes 15 − 30 = −15 kN/m, which means slack; with a 0.75 m mesh each arching cable starts at about 11.3 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「負高斯曲率鞍形索網的預拉平衡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Prestress equilibrium of anticlastic saddle nets", which statement holds?
options: 透明覆板只是遮雨用，不需要考慮熱脹與索網變形。
張拉索網就是把每個錨端各自拉到設計力即可，順序不重要。
節點平衡 p = t₁/R₁ − t₂/R₂（t 為單位寬度張力）。
optionsEn: Transparent cover panels only keep the rain out and need no allowance for thermal movement or net deformation.
Tensioning a cable net simply means pulling each anchor to its design force; order does not matter.
Node equilibrium gives p = t₁/R₁ − t₂/R₂, with t as tension per unit width.
quiz.explanation: 節點平衡 p = t₁/R₁ − t₂/R₂（t 為單位寬度張力）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Node equilibrium gives p = t₁/R₁ − t₂/R₂, with t as tension per unit width. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 負高斯曲率鞍形索網的預拉平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Prestress equilibrium of anticlastic saddle nets: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鞍形索網曲面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Saddle-shaped net surfaces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以非線性索網分析逐一檢查每個網區在雪載、風吸力、溫度與不對稱荷載下兩組索的最小張力，確認全部大於零並保有餘裕；同時檢查最大張力對索與節點的強度，以及網面最大變位是否會讓覆板之間的接縫失效。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check with nonlinear cable-net analysis, zone by zone, the minimum tension in both cable families under snow, suction, temperature and asymmetric loads, confirming all stay above zero with margin; also check maximum tension against cable and node strength, and whether maximum net displacement would break the joints between cover panels. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計文件要逐網區列出兩組索的預拉力、最小與最大張力及控制荷載組合，並把「所有組合下不鬆弛」寫成明確的驗收準則；任何改變網區形狀或荷載（例如加裝設備）的提案都要以此準則重新檢核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design documents should list, for each net zone, the prestress, minimum and maximum tension of both families and the governing combinations, stating no slack in any combination as an explicit acceptance criterion; any proposal that changes a zone's shape or loads, such as adding equipment, must be rechecked against it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：預拉力不足的網區在大雪中穩定索鬆弛，網面下陷形成積雪窪地，荷載進一步集中而撕裂覆板接縫；在風中鬆弛的索會反覆拍動，節點夾具磨損鬆脫，最後連帶損壞覆板。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A zone with too little prestress lets its arching cables go slack in heavy snow, the surface dishes into a snow pocket, load concentrates further and panel joints tear; cables that go slack in wind flap repeatedly, wearing and loosening node clamps until panels are damaged too. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以非線性索網分析逐一檢查每個網區在雪載、風吸力、溫度與不對稱荷載下兩組索的最小張力，確認全部大於零並保有餘裕；同時檢查最大張力對索與節點的強度，以及網面最大變位是否會讓覆板之間的接縫失效。
knowledge.textEn: Check with nonlinear cable-net analysis, zone by zone, the minimum tension in both cable families under snow, suction, temperature and asymmetric loads, confirming all stay above zero with margin; also check maximum tension against cable and node strength, and whether maximum net displacement would break the joints between cover panels.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計文件要逐網區列出兩組索的預拉力、最小與最大張力及控制荷載組合，並把「所有組合下不鬆弛」寫成明確的驗收準則；任何改變網區形狀或荷載（例如加裝設備）的提案都要以此準則重新檢核。
knowledge.textEn: Design documents should list, for each net zone, the prestress, minimum and maximum tension of both families and the governing combinations, stating no slack in any combination as an explicit acceptance criterion; any proposal that changes a zone's shape or loads, such as adding equipment, must be rechecked against it.

quiz.question: 要驗證「負高斯曲率鞍形索網的預拉平衡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Prestress equilibrium of anticlastic saddle nets"?
options: 以非線性索網分析逐一檢查每個網區在雪載、風吸力、溫度與不對稱荷載下兩組索的最小張力，確認全部大於零並保有餘裕。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
索網形狀看起來正確，就不必量測張力。
optionsEn: Check with nonlinear cable-net analysis, zone by zone, the minimum tension in both cable families under snow, suction, temperature and asymmetric loads, confirming all stay above zero with margin.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If a cable net looks the right shape, its tension need not be measured.
quiz.explanation: 以非線性索網分析逐一檢查每個網區在雪載、風吸力、溫度與不對稱荷載下兩組索的最小張力，確認全部大於零並保有餘裕；同時檢查最大張力對索與節點的強度，以及網面最大變位是否會讓覆板之間的接縫失效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check with nonlinear cable-net analysis, zone by zone, the minimum tension in both cable families under snow, suction, temperature and asymmetric loads, confirming all stay above zero with margin; also check maximum tension against cable and node strength, and whether maximum net displacement would break the joints between cover panels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 負高斯曲率鞍形索網的預拉平衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Prestress equilibrium of anticlastic saddle nets: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鞍形索網曲面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Saddle-shaped net surfaces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 預拉力不足的網區在大雪中穩定索鬆弛，網面下陷形成積雪窪地，荷載進一步集中而撕裂覆板接縫；在風中鬆弛的索會反覆拍動，節點夾具磨損鬆脫，最後連帶損壞覆板。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A zone with too little prestress lets its arching cables go slack in heavy snow, the surface dishes into a snow pocket, load concentrates further and panel joints tear; cables that go slack in wind flap repeatedly, wearing and loosening node clamps until panels are damaged too. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此預拉力的大小必須讓兩組索在所有荷載組合下都不鬆弛。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Prestress must therefore be large enough that neither family slackens in any load combination.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「索網只要索夠粗、夠強，就不需要預拉力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A cable net needs no prestress as long as the cables are thick and strong enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「負高斯曲率鞍形索網的預拉平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Prestress equilibrium of anticlastic saddle nets" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
預拉力不足的網區在大雪中穩定索鬆弛，網面下陷形成積雪窪地，荷載進一步集中而撕裂覆板接縫；在風中鬆弛的索會反覆拍動，節點夾具磨損鬆脫，最後連帶損壞覆板。

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A zone with too little prestress lets its arching cables go slack in heavy snow, the surface dishes into a snow pocket, load concentrates further and panel joints tear.
A heavy enough anchor block secures a cable structure, so horizontal pull does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 預拉力不足的網區在大雪中穩定索鬆弛，網面下陷形成積雪窪地，荷載進一步集中而撕裂覆板接縫；在風中鬆弛的索會反覆拍動，節點夾具磨損鬆脫，最後連帶損壞覆板。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A zone with too little prestress lets its arching cables go slack in heavy snow, the surface dishes into a snow pocket, load concentrates further and panel joints tear; cables that go slack in wind flap repeatedly, wearing and loosening node clamps until panels are damaged too. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 邊索、桅桿與重力錨塊的傳力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchors: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「440 m 邊索與錨塊」如何影響慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “440 m edge cable and anchor blocks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Munich Olympic Stadium roof”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 索網的張力在網邊匯集到邊索，邊索沿曲線把力送到桅桿頂與地錨；sbp 的資料指出邊索為全封閉鋼索，拉索為平行鋼絞線束，接頭為鑄鋼。覆蓋體育場主看台的邊索長約 440 m，由重約 4,000 t、部分埋入地下達 30 m 的混凝土錨塊錨定；整個屋蓋共用 12 支大型桅桿，最高約 80 m。桅桿只受軸壓，靠拉索保持穩定，地錨則同時承受上拔與水平拉力，是整個帳篷結構最終的反力來源。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「440 m 邊索與錨塊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Net tension gathers at the net boundary into edge cables, which carry it along their curve to mast heads and ground anchors; sbp's data give locked-coil ropes for edge cables, parallel strand bundles for guy cables and cast steel for the joints. The edge cable over the stadium's main stand is about 440 m long and is anchored by concrete blocks weighing about 4,000 t, some extending up to 30 m into the ground; the whole roof uses 12 large masts, the tallest about 80 m. Masts carry only axial compression and stay stable through their guys, while ground anchors resist both uplift and horizontal pull, the ultimate reaction of the whole tent structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “440 m edge cable and anchor blocks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：邊索受網拉力 q、曲率半徑 R 時 T = q·R：q = 20 kN/m、R = 150 m，T = 3,000 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An edge cable under net pull q with curvature radius R carries T = q·R: q = 20 kN/m and R = 150 m give T = 3,000 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錨塊夠重就能錨住索結構，水平拉力不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A heavy enough anchor block secures a cable structure, so horizontal pull does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「440 m 邊索與錨塊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “440 m edge cable and anchor blocks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchors

quiz.question: 關於「邊索、桅桿與重力錨塊的傳力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchors" is correct?
options: 錨塊夠重就能錨住索結構，水平拉力不重要。
要做出雙曲面索網，每段索都必須裁成不同長度。
索網的張力在網邊匯集到邊索，邊索沿曲線把力送到桅桿頂與地錨；sbp 的資料指出邊索為全封閉鋼索，拉索為平行鋼絞線束，接頭為鑄鋼。
optionsEn: A heavy enough anchor block secures a cable structure, so horizontal pull does not matter.
To make a doubly curved cable net, every cable segment must be cut to a different length.

steps.title: 邊索、桅桿與重力錨塊的傳力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「440 m 邊索與錨塊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “440 m edge cable and anchor blocks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：邊索受網拉力 q、曲率半徑 R 時 T = q·R：q = 20 kN/m、R = 150 m，T = 3,000 kN。若錨塊合力 F = 20,000 kN、仰角 35°，豎向 V = 20,000×sin35° ≈ 11,470 kN、水平 H ≈ 16,380 kN；錨塊重 4,000 t 即 W ≈ 39,240 kN，抗上拔係數 W/V ≈ 3.4，但底面摩擦 μ = 0.5 只提供 (W − V)×0.5 ≈ 13,880 kN，小於 H，需靠埋深的被動土壓。除錨重外為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An edge cable under net pull q with curvature radius R carries T = q·R: q = 20 kN/m and R = 150 m give T = 3,000 kN. If an anchor block takes F = 20,000 kN at 35° elevation, V = 20,000×sin35° ≈ 11,470 kN and H ≈ 16,380 kN; a 4,000 t block weighs W ≈ 39,240 kN, giving an uplift factor W/V ≈ 3.4, but base friction with μ = 0.5 supplies only (W − V)×0.5 ≈ 13,880 kN, less than H, so passive earth pressure from embedment is needed. All values except the block weight are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以非線性模型輸出每支桅桿的軸力、拉索力與每個錨塊的合力方向，檢查桅桿挫屈（含桅頂偏心）、拉索與鑄鋼接頭強度，以及錨塊的抗上拔、抗滑與地盤承載；施工時量測錨塊位移，確認被動土壓發揮前的變位在允許範圍內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Extract from the nonlinear model each mast's axial force, guy forces and the resultant direction at every anchor block; check mast buckling including head eccentricity, guy and cast-node strength, and anchor uplift, sliding and bearing; during construction survey anchor-block movement to confirm displacement before passive resistance mobilises stays within limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 邊索受網拉力 q、曲率半徑 R 時 T = q·R：q = 20 kN/m、R = 150 m，T = 3,000 kN。若錨塊合力 F = 20,000 kN、仰角 35°，豎向 V = 20,000×sin35° ≈ 11,470 kN、水平 H ≈ 16,380 kN；錨塊重 4,000 t 即 W ≈ 39,240 kN，抗上拔係數 W/V ≈ 3.4，但底面摩擦 μ = 0.5 只提供 (W − V)×0.5 ≈ 13,880 kN，小於 H，需靠埋深的被動土壓。除錨重外為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: An edge cable under net pull q with curvature radius R carries T = q·R: q = 20 kN/m and R = 150 m give T = 3,000 kN. If an anchor block takes F = 20,000 kN at 35° elevation, V = 20,000×sin35° ≈ 11,470 kN and H ≈ 16,380 kN; a 4,000 t block weighs W ≈ 39,240 kN, giving an uplift factor W/V ≈ 3.4, but base friction with μ = 0.5 supplies only (W − V)×0.5 ≈ 13,880 kN, less than H, so passive earth pressure from embedment is needed. All values except the block weight are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「邊索、桅桿與重力錨塊的傳力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchors", which statement holds?
options: 邊索受網拉力 q、曲率半徑 R 時 T = q·R：q = 20 kN/m、R = 150 m，T = 3,000 kN。
桅桿完成後就很穩定，吊網時不需要額外的臨時拉索。
實體模型做得夠精細，就可以直接用來定出索長。

Once masts are erected they are stable, so no extra temporary guys are needed while lifting nets.
A sufficiently detailed physical model can be used directly to set cable lengths.
quiz.explanation: 邊索受網拉力 q、曲率半徑 R 時 T = q·R：q = 20 kN/m、R = 150 m，T = 3,000 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An edge cable under net pull q with curvature radius R carries T = q·R: q = 20 kN/m and R = 150 m give T = 3,000 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 邊索、桅桿與重力錨塊的傳力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchors: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「440 m 邊索與錨塊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “440 m edge cable and anchor blocks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以非線性模型輸出每支桅桿的軸力、拉索力與每個錨塊的合力方向，檢查桅桿挫屈（含桅頂偏心）、拉索與鑄鋼接頭強度，以及錨塊的抗上拔、抗滑與地盤承載；施工時量測錨塊位移，確認被動土壓發揮前的變位在允許範圍內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Extract from the nonlinear model each mast's axial force, guy forces and the resultant direction at every anchor block; check mast buckling including head eccentricity, guy and cast-node strength, and anchor uplift, sliding and bearing; during construction survey anchor-block movement to confirm displacement before passive resistance mobilises stays within limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每個錨塊與桅桿基礎都要有獨立的承載、抗拔與抗滑計算，並在設計報告中做單一拉索或錨具失效的情境分析；錨塊周邊的開挖或回填變更須經結構工程師同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Each anchor block and mast foundation needs its own bearing, uplift and sliding calculation, and the design report should analyse the loss of a single guy or anchorage; any excavation or backfill change around an anchor block requires the structural engineer's agreement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錨塊只按重量抗上拔設計而忽略水平分力，受力後錨塊滑移，邊索與網面張力同時下降，網面下垂；桅桿拉索若有一根斷裂或錨具失效，桅桿失穩會牽動整片網，這也是索結構需要檢討單一構件失效後果的原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing an anchor for uplift by weight alone and ignoring the horizontal component lets the block slide under load, dropping tension in the edge cable and net together so the surface sags; if one mast guy breaks or its anchorage fails, mast instability drags the whole net, which is why cable structures need an assessment of single-member loss. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以非線性模型輸出每支桅桿的軸力、拉索力與每個錨塊的合力方向，檢查桅桿挫屈（含桅頂偏心）、拉索與鑄鋼接頭強度，以及錨塊的抗上拔、抗滑與地盤承載；施工時量測錨塊位移，確認被動土壓發揮前的變位在允許範圍內。
knowledge.textEn: Extract from the nonlinear model each mast's axial force, guy forces and the resultant direction at every anchor block; check mast buckling including head eccentricity, guy and cast-node strength, and anchor uplift, sliding and bearing; during construction survey anchor-block movement to confirm displacement before passive resistance mobilises stays within limits.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每個錨塊與桅桿基礎都要有獨立的承載、抗拔與抗滑計算，並在設計報告中做單一拉索或錨具失效的情境分析；錨塊周邊的開挖或回填變更須經結構工程師同意。
knowledge.textEn: Each anchor block and mast foundation needs its own bearing, uplift and sliding calculation, and the design report should analyse the loss of a single guy or anchorage; any excavation or backfill change around an anchor block requires the structural engineer's agreement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「邊索、桅桿與重力錨塊的傳力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchors"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以非線性模型輸出每支桅桿的軸力、拉索力與每個錨塊的合力方向，檢查桅桿挫屈（含桅頂偏心）、拉索與鑄鋼接頭強度，以及錨塊的抗上拔、抗滑與地盤承載。
只要覆板防火性能更好，就一定是更好的材料。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Extract from the nonlinear model each mast's axial force, guy forces and the resultant direction at every anchor block.
A cover panel with better fire performance is always the better material.
quiz.explanation: 以非線性模型輸出每支桅桿的軸力、拉索力與每個錨塊的合力方向，檢查桅桿挫屈（含桅頂偏心）、拉索與鑄鋼接頭強度，以及錨塊的抗上拔、抗滑與地盤承載；施工時量測錨塊位移，確認被動土壓發揮前的變位在允許範圍內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Extract from the nonlinear model each mast's axial force, guy forces and the resultant direction at every anchor block; check mast buckling including head eccentricity, guy and cast-node strength, and anchor uplift, sliding and bearing; during construction survey anchor-block movement to confirm displacement before passive resistance mobilises stays within limits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 邊索、桅桿與重力錨塊的傳力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchors: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「440 m 邊索與錨塊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “440 m edge cable and anchor blocks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錨塊只按重量抗上拔設計而忽略水平分力，受力後錨塊滑移，邊索與網面張力同時下降，網面下垂；桅桿拉索若有一根斷裂或錨具失效，桅桿失穩會牽動整片網，這也是索結構需要檢討單一構件失效後果的原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing an anchor for uplift by weight alone and ignoring the horizontal component lets the block slide under load, dropping tension in the edge cable and net together so the surface sags; if one mast guy breaks or its anchorage fails, mast instability drags the whole net, which is why cable structures need an assessment of single-member loss. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：桅桿只受軸壓，靠拉索保持穩定，地錨則同時承受上拔與水平拉力，是整個帳篷結構最終的反力來源。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Masts carry only axial compression and stay stable through their guys, while ground anchors resist both uplift and horizontal pull, the ultimate reaction of the whole tent structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錨塊夠重就能錨住索結構，水平拉力不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A heavy enough anchor block secures a cable structure, so horizontal pull does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錨塊只按重量抗上拔設計而忽略水平分力，受力後錨塊滑移，邊索與網面張力同時下降，網面下垂；桅桿拉索若有一根斷裂或錨具失效，桅桿失穩會牽動整片網，這也是索結構需要檢討單一構件失效後果的原因。
knowledge.textEn: Designing an anchor for uplift by weight alone and ignoring the horizontal component lets the block slide under load, dropping tension in the edge cable and net together so the surface sags; if one mast guy breaks or its anchorage fails, mast instability drags the whole net, which is why cable structures need an assessment of single-member loss.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「邊索、桅桿與重力錨塊的傳力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchors" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
要做出雙曲面索網，每段索都必須裁成不同長度。
錨塊只按重量抗上拔設計而忽略水平分力，受力後錨塊滑移，邊索與網面張力同時下降，網面下垂。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
To make a doubly curved cable net, every cable segment must be cut to a different length.
Designing an anchor for uplift by weight alone and ignoring the horizontal component lets the block slide under load, dropping tension in the edge cable and net together so the surface sags.
quiz.explanation: 錨塊只按重量抗上拔設計而忽略水平分力，受力後錨塊滑移，邊索與網面張力同時下降，網面下垂；桅桿拉索若有一根斷裂或錨具失效，桅桿失穩會牽動整片網，這也是索結構需要檢討單一構件失效後果的原因。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing an anchor for uplift by weight alone and ignoring the horizontal component lets the block slide under load, dropping tension in the edge cable and net together so the surface sags; if one mast guy breaks or its anchorage fails, mast instability drags the whole net, which is why cable structures need an assessment of single-member loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
